title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-improving LLM agents edit their own harness, the prompts and rules around a fixed model, and keep an edit only if an acceptance gate scores it higher on a batch of tasks. Such a gate sees what the harness does under the current model, not what it would still prevent if one safeguard failed. When safeguards overlap, deleting one is masked: the others still block the harm, so the gate decides on task success alone and redundancy erodes unseen. We measure harm for every subset of four written safeguards in two agent environments and run 411 improvement loops under ten gate rules, mostly as controlled deletion experiments, plus three runs of the GEPA optimizer. A deletion behind another working safeguard adds almost no observable harm. A paired significance test blocks deletions that pass by chance but not deletions that genuinely raise task success, and a larger evaluation batch lets it delete cheaper safeguards: at the same cost, 20-t

translated_title: 掩蔽侵蚀：自我改进智能体中的接受门如何丢失冗余安全保障
translated_abstract: 自我改进的LLM智能体会编辑自身的运行框架（harness），即围绕固定模型的提示词和规则，并且只有当接受门在一批任务上给该编辑打出更高分数时才保留该编辑。这样的接受门只能看到运行框架在当前模型下的表现，而看不到当某一安全保障失效时它原本还能阻止什么。当多个安全保障相互重叠时，删除其中一个的危害会被掩盖：其余的安全保障仍能阻止相应危害，因此接受门仅凭任务成功与否做决定，冗余防护便在无形中被侵蚀。我们在两个智能体环境中测量了四个书面安全保障的每个子集所对应的危害，并在十种门规则下运行了411个改进循环（主要作为受控删除实验），另外还进行了三次GEPA优化器运行。结果表明，在另一个仍在生效的安全保障之后进行的删除几乎不会带来可观察到的危害。配对显著性检验能够阻止偶然通过的删除，却无法阻止真正提升任务成功率的删除，而更大的评估批次使接受门能够删除成本更低的安全保障：在相同成本下，20-t（摘要截断）
tldr: 论文揭示自我改进LLM智能体的接受门因安全保障之间的冗余重叠而无法察觉删除行为带来的危害，导致冗余安全防护在自动改进过程中被无声侵蚀。
en_tdlr: Acceptance gates in self-improving LLM agents mask the deletion of redundant safeguards because overlapping protections still block harm, causing silent erosion of safety redundancy across improvement loops.
